key.name: asr-backend
key.description: The transcription binary preset. Only 'transcribe-cli' (transcribe.cpp) is supported; the key is kept for compatibility with existing profiles.

key.name: cli-mode
key.description: How to resolve the transcription binary. 'cpu' uses the CPU-only transcribe-cli bundled with the extension (x86_64), falling back to a transcribe-cli found on PATH. 'gpu' uses the absolute path set in cli-path (e.g. a Vulkan/CUDA build) and forces the Vulkan accelerator so inference runs on the GPU. Legacy values 'auto' and 'manual' are migrated at load time to 'cpu' and 'gpu' respectively.

key.name: cli-path
key.description: Absolute path to the transcription CLI binary.

key.name: model-params
key.description: Extra arguments passed to the binary (model path, language, ...). Quote paths with spaces.

key.name: realtime-mode
key.description: When recording stops, the whole take is processed in a single pass driven by the CLI streaming API (--stream-chunk-ms), and the transcript is delivered progressively as the model produces it. With paste output the text is typed at the cursor sequentially; with clipboard output the full text is copied once when processing finishes. Language is forced to auto-detection in this mode (streaming models advertise BCP-47 language codes that the short ISO codes from the picker do not match). Enabling this disables the Long recordings / live chunking options.

key.name: extra-cli-flags
key.description: Optional extra flags appended to every transcription command, after the model params and feature flags, before the audio path. Left blank means none. Quote values with spaces.

key.name: active-model-id
key.description: Id of the active catalog model. When empty, the free-form model-params string is used instead.

key.name: model-dir
key.description: Directory where downloaded models are stored. Empty means ~/.cache/planeasr/models.

key.name: quant-preference
key.description: Quantization selected by default when a model offers several files (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, Q6_K, Q8_0, F16, F32).

key.name: accelerator
key.description: Compute backend: auto (let the CLI pick), cpu, or vulkan.

key.name: gpu-device
key.description: Index of the GPU device to use. -1 means auto-detect.

key.name: selected-language
key.description: ISO 639-1 language code or 'auto' for detection.

key.name: translate-to-english
key.description: Translate the transcription to English when the model supports it.

key.name: cpu-threads
key.description: Number of CPU threads to use. 0 means auto (all available cores).

key.name: initial-prompt
key.description: Custom vocabulary or context biasing passed as the model initial prompt.

key.name: chunk-enabled
key.description: Transcribe long recordings live in N-second chunks while recording, streaming each piece as it is ready, so backends with a per-call generation cap (e.g. Qwen3-ASR) don't truncate the output.

key.name: chunk-seconds
key.description: Length in seconds of each chunk when 'chunk-enabled' is true. Lower values are safer for models that cap output tokens per call.

key.name: chunk-overlap-seconds
key.description: Seconds of audio re-transcribed at the boundary between consecutive chunks so words split across the seam are not lost. The overlapping text is removed with fuzzy matching. 0 disables overlap.

key.name: output-mode
key.description: Where to send the transcribed text: 'clipboard' or 'paste'.

key.name: keep-records
key.description: Number of most recent WAV recordings to keep under records/. Older files are pruned after each successful transcription. 0 keeps none (deletes a recording right after transcribing it); set a large value to keep everything.

key.name: last-text
key.description: The text produced by the last successful transcription.

key.name: toggle-record-shortcut
key.description: Global keybinding that starts/stops recording. Defaults to Ctrl+Alt+Space; clear it in Preferences to disable.

key.name: push-to-talk-shortcut
key.description: Global keybinding that records only while held: recording starts when the combination is pressed and stops when the modifier keys are released. Requires at least one modifier (Ctrl/Shift/Alt/Super) so the release can be detected. Defaults to Ctrl+Shift+Space; clear it in Preferences to disable.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Log the ASR command line and its captured stdout/stderr to the system journal for troubleshooting.
